title: Notion Plus to self-hosted AFFiNE
summary: AFFiNE merges a document editor with an infinite canvas. At three seats, the question is whether that is worth becoming its operator.

you_lose: A decade of templates, integrations and institutional familiarity
you_gain: A whiteboard and a document editor in the same file, which Notion does not offer
Local-first storage with real offline editing

caveats: AFFiNE moves fast and its self-hosted releases have been less stable than the hosted product. Pin a version and read the upgrade notes before every bump.
Three seats of Notion Plus is $360 a year. That is a low bar for a VPS plus your hours to clear, and this page will often say so.
